input.summary: Complete Kenny and one more character mode, hit the Mr. Hankey targets five times, then shoot the ramp to start Multiball. Use completed character shots for Double Jackpots and collect the ramp Super Jackpot after five Mr. Hankey Jackpots.

quickInfo.name: Character modes
quickInfo.summary: Hit one character's shot four times to start that mode. A completed character stays solidly lit on the playfield.

quickInfo.name: Kenny
quickInfo.summary: Hit Kenny four times to start his hurry-up, then hit him once more to collect it and complete the mode.

quickInfo.name: Mr. Hankey Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Hit the three Mr. Hankey targets five times, then shoot the lit ramp to start five-ball play.

quickInfo.name: Double and Super Jackpots
quickInfo.summary: Completed character shots score Double Jackpots. Five Mr. Hankey Jackpots light the ramp for the Super Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Volcano
quickInfo.summary: Complete all five character modes to qualify the final five-ball Multiball.

steps.text: Hit Kenny four times to start his hurry-up, then hit Kenny once more to collect it.
Hit another character's shot four times to start its mode, then make that mode's lit objective shots until its character insert stays solidly lit.
Hit the three Mr. Hankey targets five times, then shoot the lit ramp to start Mr. Hankey Multiball.
During Multiball, shoot the Mr. Hankey targets for Jackpots and the completed character shots for Double Jackpots.
After five Mr. Hankey Jackpots, shoot the ramp for the Super Jackpot. Collecting it doubles the value of the next Jackpot round.
Complete the other four character modes in the safest order.
Start Volcano and use the five balls for lit major shots.

playfieldReferences.context: Hit the three Mr. Hankey targets
playfieldReferences.label: Mr. Hankey targets
playfieldReferences.description: The three targets in front of the toilet qualify Multiball and score Jackpots.

playfieldReferences.label: Multiball ramp
playfieldReferences.description: The ramp starts Mr. Hankey Multiball and collects its Super Jackpot.

techniques.name: Kenny first
techniques.instruction: Hit Kenny four times, then hit him once more for the collect. His single objective makes him the shortest character mode to finish.

techniques.name: Cartman kickout
techniques.instruction: Keep both flippers ready and learn the sinkhole eject before repeating Cartman.

cautions.issue: Ramp exits, character-shot counts, uncensored sound, post configuration, and ball saves vary by ROM and operator setup.
cautions.response: Verify mode completion on the display and choose a different character when the current feed is unsafe.
